status.description: BLOCKED = ticket-level block (RFC § 1.2/VERIFY debug cap), distinct from session-level STATE.phase: BLOCKED

blocker.description: Active facts + dead ends. Present and non-empty exactly when status is BLOCKED; absent for every other status.

review_passes.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field; phases/review.md uses it to enforce its two-pass cap mechanically rather than from memory. Absent from this schema until v7.101.0.

verify_attempts.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field; absent reads as zero. Counts the current failed-fix-cycle budget phases/verify.md spends on this ticket. Canonical unblock clears the current budget while journaled events retain history. The cap number itself lives in phases/verify.md and is read from there, never copied.

source_reports.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field (T-556): sweep provenance, the composite IMP-### identities a canonical ticket was generated from. Resolved by the [sweep-ticket-link] validator check against SWEEP.md; a reference that resolves to no disposition, or a ticket produced by an unverified or INVALID/ALREADY_FIXED finding, FAILs.

source_receipts.description: Comma-separated immutable SRC-NNN authority links. Full source bodies stay under .saipen/intake and are never copied onto BOARD.

recurrence.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field (T-558): the META-IMPROVEMENT reasoning a protocol-level improve ticket MUST record -- the cross-project recurrence analysis (a protocol-level fix records whether the defect recurs across projects; a local bug stays local). Required by the [sweep-ticket-link] check for a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION finding that produced a ticket.

weak_model.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field (T-558): the WEAK-MODEL PRECEDENT answer -- could a weak but compliant model still choose wrong while honestly believing it followed SAIPEN? Required by the [sweep-ticket-link] check for a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION finding that produced a ticket.

regression.description: CORE-001: `required` declares that this ticket owes a regression PAIR -- a FAIL against the pre-fix subject and a PASS against the post-fix one under the SAME verifier -- and arms the extra gate in VERIFY -> REVIEW and finish. A machine-owned field, never inferred from prose.

allOf.description: blocker is active blocked-state data: present and non-empty exactly under BLOCKED (T-631)
